args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring (and FIN-212)
specify banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), which broke
tests/test_money.py in the nightly build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed in `tests/test_money.py`: the test expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) for half-cent values, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching both the FIN-212 requirement and the function's docstring.

## Verification
- New branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`, fix commit `08d3cd5986`.
- CI run `ci-0001` on that commit: **passed** (all tests green).

Fixes the failing test case: `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`.

@code-owner — requesting your approval to merge into main so this ships in today's release.
